reason: The report regresses export growth on supplier diversity with no controls, although the data include pre-period confounders (2020 sales, export experience, prior export growth) that correlate with diversity at about 0.2–0.3. When I added the 2020 pre-period controls, the coefficient fell from 2.55 (untrimmed, no controls) to 0.69, so the reported 2.23 is mostly confounding. The magnitude is not supported, and the unadjusted regression with a single specification should not be released.
